findings.text: F2 NOT ADDRESSED (acceptance 3): age alone evicts a live lock owner; atalk.ts:82 duplicates this. VM reproduction: pause A after reading the list, advance 31s, complete B, resume A => completed=2, paths=[existing,a], lostEntry=b, including mixed plugin/atalk writers. Disabling age-based eviction prevents the loss. Use ownership-safe locking that cannot evict live writers, and test overlapping updates.

The new lock failure leaves an unignored credential. VM reproduction: hold a fresh trust lock and run atalkMain(['login','--url',url,'--token','-','--local']) in a git directory => exit=1, credentialExists=true, gitignoreExists=false; an existing credential is overwritten too. The baseline succeeds and adds the ignore entry. Acquire the lock before modifying credentials, or restore prior state and ensure ignore protection before writing; test timeout failures.

F3 NOT ADDRESSED fully: directory/FIFO/symlink reproductions now refuse with zero writes, but temporary-file cleanup is still missing. VM reproduction: inject EPERM at renameSync(tmp, trusted-projects.json) => exit=1, credentialExists=false, trustTemps=1. A failed login leaves trusted-projects.json.<pid>.<random>.tmp behind. Clean up the temporary file on write/rename failure and add a failure-injection regression test.
